config.name: np-exact-local
config.description: Local (single-step) order check, Part C of pfexact: ||G(d) - exp(-idH)|| ~ d^(p+1) for all eleven formulas on the full Heisenberg chain (J = 1, periodic), NumPy fields seed 1, n = 4 and 6, against exact diagonalisation. Added after np-exact's Part B (ii) failed for S8 (n = 4, 6) and M&O q=14 (n = 6), diagnosed as r-fold rounding accumulation and pre-asymptotic points in a fixed error window. np-exact is kept unchanged as the original result. Criteria fixed 2026-11-11 before this run.

local._note: d_k = 2^(-k/2), k = 0..20. Floor = tol_per_exponential (Part A's rounding tolerance) x exponentials per step; a point is usable at >= 100x floor. Fit the 4 smallest usable d. Chosen before any single-step data were computed; informed by the np-exact Part B data.
